rationale: BotNira needs to feel authoritative, reliable, and functional. Avoiding the cliché 'purple/teal AI' look, we're utilizing a Swiss Brutalism approach. Stark white backgrounds, heavy black borders for definition, and International Klein Blue for striking CTAs. This creates a dense, readable dashboard and a highly credible marketing page.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
typography.notes: Do not use Inter for headings. Keep typography sharp and heavy for headers, and highly legible for data.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for major marketing sections. Use tighter p-4 to p-6 for dashboard cards.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm (2px) to maintain the brutalist/swiss aesthetic.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the grid. Use border-collapse patterns. 1px or 2px solid black borders for cards and inputs.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Hard neo-brutalist shadows: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,11,1)] for interactive elements instead of soft blurs.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Grid items must be direct children. Use dense, bento-style layouts for the unified inbox.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering should translate buttons slightly (-translate-x-[2px] -translate-y-[2px]) and increase hard shadow depth. ALWAYS set hover text color.

component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges, 2px solid black borders. Primary buttons should be International Klein Blue with white text.
component_instructions.cards: Flat background (white or very light gray), 1px or 2px solid black border, hard shadow on hover.
component_instructions.navigation: Sticky, solid bottom border (border-b-2 border-black). Do not use fully transparent navs.
component_instructions.unified_inbox: Three-pane layout: Sidebar (Channels/Nav) > Message List (with colored badges for channels) > Active Thread (with AI transcript in a distinctive mono-font sidebar block).
component_instructions.bot_trainer: Wizard format. Step-by-step forms. Input fields with hard black borders on focus.
component_instructions.analytics: Use simple, high-contrast bar charts or line charts in recharts. Avoid gradient fills in charts.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

hero_architecture.description: Clean modern architecture against blue sky, used for the marketing hero or background.

geometric_abstract.description: Abstract geometric swiss design, used for decorative elements on the landing page.

team_meeting.description: Team meeting placeholder, can be used for 'Superadmin' or 'Agency' context.

user_avatar_1.description: Avatar for active user or bot preview customer.

user_avatar_2.description: Avatar for incoming message in unified inbox.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add fonts via Google Fonts: <link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@900,800,700,500,400,300&f[]=satoshi@900,700,500,400,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"> in index.html.
Add <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Azeret+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"> for the mono font.
For the unified inbox, use a rigorous 3-pane dashboard layout (Sidebar, Threads, Chat View).
For the Bot Trainer Wizard, use a stepper with bold typography.
Apply the Swiss High-Contrast styling: strong black borders (border-black), stark white backgrounds, and International Klein Blue (#002FA7) for primary actions.
Do NOT use soft rounded corners. Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm.
Do NOT use generic 'AI gradients' (no purple/teal blur).
Implement neo-brutalist shadows (solid colored offsets) instead of soft box-shadows.
Include recharts for the analytics view.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
